sources.finding: WITH NO DATA builds column definitions from target expression type, typmod and collation; creates an ordinary relation with no inherited constraints; may create TOAST outside public projection.
Simple column definitions start local, zero inheritance, nullable, with no defaults/constraints/options; type/typmod/collation are explicit.

Plain index column descriptors use fresh ordinals/local state; copy type, length, dimensions, typmod, by-value, alignment, storage and compression from heap attributes. Collation is supplied by key position.
Fresh attributes initialize nullable/no default/no missing/no identity/no generated/no dropped state, local with zero inheritance; storage/type physical metadata come from the type.
Consulted implementation path. The model uses same-database pristine unique/FK and type templates; no unverified new catalog constants are learned from fault rows.
